name: Diagnose an async queue that runs its handlers concurrently
prompt: Run the project's tests, diagnose the failure across src/, fix the implementation, and verify that all tests pass. src/queue.js processAll() starts every handler at once, so the work interleaves instead of running in task order and the start/end log comes out wrong. Rewrite processAll() so handlers run one at a time, in task order, and resolved values are returned in that same order.
